summary: AI Marketplace Architecture (213 agents / 22 categories / 37 features) — full backend + frontend validation. Backend: 28/28 existing pytest suite + 13/13 new supplemental tests pass (41/41). Frontend: all Portfolio + Agents interactive flows verified via Playwright against localhost:3000, including bulk status update, clone, pagination, search, category/status filters, and zero-regression on Workflows/Executions/Tools tabs.

ui_bugs.component: AI Agents panel — Bulk selection UX
ui_bugs.issue: After clicking a bulk action (e.g., Set Beta), the panel automatically exits bulk-select mode AND clears the selection set. As a consequence, to run a second bulk action on the same agents the user must re-open Bulk select and re-tick each checkbox. Testing agents / users expecting the selection to persist can be surprised. Minor UX/design consideration — not a functional bug (state clearing is intentional per runBulk in ai-agents.tsx).

action_items: (Optional / LOW) Consider keeping bulk-select mode + selection set active after a bulk action so consecutive actions (e.g., Set Beta then Enable) don't require re-selecting. Currently runBulk() in /app/frontend/app/admin/ai-agents.tsx calls setSelectedIds(new Set()) + setSelectMode(false) on success — intentional but affected the 2nd half of the Set Beta → Enable browser flow. Not a bug — tester compensated by restoring via API.
critical_code_review_comments: AgentPortfolioTab.tsx is well-scoped (~194 lines), uses Promise.all for 4 marketplace endpoints, proper loading/error states with testids, and every readiness check row has data-testid=readiness-check-{name}. No changes needed.
ai-agents.tsx testIDs are consistent and derived from labels (agent-bulk-{label-slug}, agent-clone-{key}, agent-status-badge-{key}, agent-status-filter-{status}). Enables robust automation.
Marketplace endpoints properly gated behind admin auth (anon receives 401/403 for /marketplace/portfolio). Bulk-status validates the status enum server-side (400 on 'bogus').

Zero-regression confirmed: legacy /agent-framework/overview reports agents=213 tools=3; /agents, /agents/{key}, /agents/{key}/versions, /workflows, /executions, /tools, /prompts, /policy, /audit all return 200. POST /agents upsert accepts new marketplace fields (subcategory, feature_mappings, status, availability, permissions as list, config_profile) and DELETE cleans up.
Portfolio coverage matrix correctly reports 37/37 covered with coverage_percent=100.0 and uncovered_features=[].

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all functional checks pass; the only miss was the browser-side status-restore step because bulk mode auto-exits after each action (restored via API)

seed_data_creation: Temporary agent TEST_marketplace_upsert_iter873 created + deleted inside pytest. Clone ai_ethics_reviewer_clone_zu1m was created via UI during the browser flow — DELETED via API cleanup at end of run (verified 404). Bulk status flip on ai_ethics_reviewer + api_designer to 'beta' was RESTORED to 'active' via /marketplace/bulk-status after the browser flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is a static export served by expo_manual on port 3000 (do NOT rebuild it). Preview URL is Cloudflare-challenged for browser automation but works fine for curl/requests. Login flow: navigate to /auth/login, fill [data-testid=login-email-input] + [data-testid=login-password-input], click text='SIGN IN'. Admin lands on /. Then goto /admin/ai-agents. The 5 tabs use testid ai-agents-tab-{portfolio|agents|workflows|executions|tools}. Note: bulk actions auto-exit bulk mode + clear selection, so multi-step bulk flows in Playwright require re-toggling bulk select and re-ticking checkboxes between actions.
